chemistry-e1-q4.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.

chemistry-killer-01.title: Daakuu kooppara (Cu) weenii
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Daakuu kooppara (Cu) weenii cufaa keessatti oksijiinii ($\mathrm{O_2}$) waliin raawwachiisuun kooppara oksaayidii (Ⅱ) ($\mathrm{CuO}$) hojjechuuf qorannoo geggeessine. Qorannoo hunda keessatti $\mathrm{O_2}$ weenii keessa jiru 2.0 g dha, raawwiin $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$ dha. Ulfaatinni CuO raawwii booda uumame akka armaan gadiiti.
(ka) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(kb) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(kc) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Haala wal-fakkaatuun seerri dhiyeenya qixa yoo dhugaa ta'e, weenii wal-fakkaatu keessatti Cu 14.0 g fi $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g hanga wanti raawwatu tokko guutummaatti fixutti raawwachiisnee bu'aan sirrii ta'e kam?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.prompt:
Daakuu kooppara (Cu) weenii cufaa keessatti oksijiinii ($\mathrm{O_2}$) waliin raawwachiisuun kooppara oksaayidii (Ⅱ) ($\mathrm{CuO}$) hojjechuuf qorannoo geggeessine. Qorannoo hunda keessatti $\mathrm{O_2}$ weenii keessa jiru 2.0 g dha, raawwiin $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$ dha. Ulfaatinni CuO raawwii booda uumame akka armaan gadiiti.
(ka) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(kb) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(kc) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Haala wal-fakkaatuun seerri dhiyeenya qixa yoo dhugaa ta'e, weenii wal-fakkaatu keessatti Cu 14.0 g fi $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g hanga wanti raawwatu tokko guutummaatti fixutti raawwachiisnee bu'aan sirrii ta'e kam?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
Tarkaanfii 1: Cu yoo dabalamus CuO 10.0 g irraa kan hin dabalamne (kc) $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2.0 g weenii keessaa hundi kan raawwate waan ta'eef CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, jechuunis Cu:O = 4:1 dha (mirkaneessa: (ka) Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g dha, O hafa; (kb) Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g dha, hir'inni/dabaleen hin jiru; (kc) Cu 4.0 g hafa).
Tarkaanfii 2: O guutummaatti Cu 14.0 g waliin raawwatu = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. $\mathrm{O_2}$ kenname 4.0 g caalaa waan ta'eef Cu hundi raawwatee $\mathrm{O_2}$ $4.0-3.5=0.5$ g hafa.
Tarkaanfii 3: CuO uumame = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (eegumsa ulfaatinaa, dhiyeenya qixa Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Kanaaf deebiin sirrii a: CuO 17.5 g uumame, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0.5 g hafe. (Deebii dogoggoraa: ida'ama ulfaatinaa 18.0 g gatii O hin raawwatin of-keessaa qabuu dha, 20.0 g O 4.0 g irratti hundaa'uun Cu dhiphachuu tuffachuudhaan lakkaa'ame dha)
chemistry-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
